Sculpture and Three-Dimensional Studies — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Sculpture and Three-Dimensional Studies.
